text:
Dana H: Quick drop 1 1 1 1 1  
I'm prototyping a tiny "microspark" card set for goals + self-reviews. Meant to be pasteable into a review form or 1:1 notes. Want a fast thumbs up or minor edits. :sparkles:

Dana H: Core constraints: <=3 lines, include one evidence tag, one beneficiary line, and an optional risk note. Also a one-sentence manager script for 1:1s.

Dana H: Example cards (copy-paste):
"Scope: infra
Goal: Reduce P95 inference latency by 14% for chat-api (us-west)
Evidence: dash-512 (P95 -14%) | Beneficiary: Search [Evidence:A] [Risk:Low]"

Dana H: Manager script (1 sentence): "Tell me one change you shipped that moved a metric and one thing you want me to unblock."

Ravi S: Love it. Can we add a one-word confidence tag (H/M/L) so reviewers know metric trust level?

Dana H: Good call 1 adding [Conf:H/M/L] optional.

Gabe (Eng Manager): Suggest peer-quote guidance: "Peer: one-sentence on the candidate's strongest impact - <name>" encouraged but not required. Helps managers who want qualitative evidence.

Marta (People Ops): Also add a tiny hiring ops reminder footer: "If growth/promo expected, file Hiring Ops request within 10 days -> hiring-template". We'll link in handbook.

Dana H: Plan: fold in confidence tag + peer prompt + hiring note, then publish as "Microspark goal cards" in the handbook and add a prefill option in the review form. Will pilot in Gabe's org next cycle.

hr-bot: Draft posted: https://handbook.redwood.company/people-ops/microspark-cards (internal)

Gabe (Eng Manager): Will pilot and share uptake metrics. LGTM.
